snippet.description:
Learn Change of Variables in Partial Differentiation and Differential Equations for BSc Maths. Master transformation to Polar Coordinates and Laplace equation step-by-step.

Is lecture mein hum Partial Differentiation & Differential Calculus ke ek important topic Change of Variables (चरों का परिवर्तन) ko detail mein samjhenge.

Agar aap B.Sc. Maths / B.Sc. B.Ed / B.Tech / Engineering Mathematics ke student hain, toh yeh lecture aapke university exams aur competitive exams ke liye extremely helpful hai.

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:
Concept Recap: Total Derivative aur Chain Rule ka use variable change mein kaise hota hai.
Example 1: Substitution $x = 1/z$ se differential equation ko transform karna aur invariant proof karna.
Example 2: Substitution $x = \tan z$ apply karke complex differential equation ko simplify karna.
Important Problem (Polar Form): Cartesian Laplace Equation $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0$ ko Polar Coordinates $(r, \theta)$ mein transform karna with full step-by-step derivation.

Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Recap (Chain Rule & Total Derivative)
02:08 – Example 1: Invariant Differential Equation with Substitution $x = 1/z$
10:08 – Example 2: Transforming Differential Equation with $x = \tan z$
17:30 – Transformation to Polar Coordinates $(r, \theta)$
19:55 – Calculating Partial Derivatives of $r$ and $\theta$ w.r.t. $x$ and $y$
22:45 – First Order Partial Derivatives ($\partial u/\partial x$)
24:20 – Second Order Partial Derivatives ($\partial^2 u/\partial x^2$)
30:05 – Second Order Partial Derivatives ($\partial^2 u/\partial y^2$)
32:46 – Transforming Laplace Equation into Polar Form
35:02 – Summary & What's Next (Implicit Functions)

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Total Derivatives & Chain Rule for Composite Functions  → https://youtu.be/MDHF8WiDh6o

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
